config.sip.profile.connected: The account is connected. Check the remaining phone functions below.
config.sip.profile.restart_text: Restart AuraGo once so the browser phone can use the new audio settings.
config.sip.delete.title: Delete SIP profile?
config.sip.delete.text: This removes the account settings and the stored SIP password. It cannot be undone.
config.sip.diagnostic.dns_failed: The SIP server name could not be resolved. Check the provider or server address.
config.sip.diagnostic.unreachable: The SIP server is not reachable. Check the address, network, and router.
config.sip.diagnostic.authentication_fai: The SIP server rejected the login. Check the username and SIP password.
config.sip.diagnostic.rejected: The SIP server rejected the registration. Check whether this account permits another device.
config.sip.diagnostic.timeout: The SIP server did not respond in time. Check the network and try again.
config.sip.diagnostic.failed: The connection test failed. Review the account details and try again.
config.sip.wizard.calling_title: What calls should this phone allow?
config.sip.wizard.outbound_intro: Outgoing browser calls are enabled by default. Choose the range that suits this account.
config.sip.wizard.scope_all_desc: Allow international E.164 numbers with prefixes +1 through +9 within the exact account domain.
config.sip.wizard.scope_domestic_desc: Allow national dialling and this provider's country code.
config.sip.wizard.scope_custom_desc: Allow only the numbers or extensions you enter.
config.sip.wizard.custom_targets_hint: Separate exact numbers, extensions or E.164 prefixes with commas. No wildcards.
config.sip.wizard.custom_targets_require: Enter at least one allowed number or extension.
config.sip.wizard.inbound_enable_desc: Off by default. AuraGo detects the trusted phone-system addresses automatically when enabled.
config.sip.wizard.callers_all_desc: Accept every caller arriving from the detected phone system.
config.sip.wizard.callers_custom_desc: Accept only the caller numbers or extensions you enter.
config.sip.wizard.custom_callers_require: Enter at least one allowed caller.
config.sip.wizard.verify_check_title: AuraGo checks the setup for you
config.sip.wizard.verify_check_text: The profile is saved atomically, then AuraGo immediately tests registration. You stay here if anything needs attention.
config.sip.wizard.custom_value_invalid: “{value}” is not an individual number or extension.
config.sip.allowed_domains_help: Empty uses the account domain. Otherwise only the exact listed domains are allowed.
config.sip.allowed_users_help: Empty user and E.164 prefix lists deny outgoing calls.
config.sip.outbound_policy_migration_req: Wildcard outbound rules no longer grant access. Replace them with exact destinations before saving.
config.sip.help.enabled: Turns the SIP endpoint on. Without it AuraGo does not register with your phone provider.
config.sip.help.readonly: The agent can read the phone status but cannot answer, start or end calls.
config.sip.help.registrar: Address of the SIP server of your provider or phone system that AuraGo signs in to.
config.sip.help.domain: SIP domain of the account, usually the same as the registrar. It forms the address user@domain.
config.sip.help.username: User name or phone number of the SIP account as given by your provider.
config.sip.help.auth_username: Only fill in if the provider requires a different name for sign-in than the user name.
config.sip.help.display_name: Name that can be shown as the caller on outgoing calls (max. 100 characters).
config.sip.help.outbound_proxy: Optional proxy that carries all SIP messages. Leave empty if your provider does not require one.
config.sip.help.clear_password: Deletes the stored SIP password on save. Signing in is no longer possible afterwards.
config.sip.help.bind_host: Local address on which AuraGo receives SIP messages. 127.0.0.1 only accepts connections from this device.
config.sip.help.bind_port: Local SIP port (1-65535). The default is 5060; change it only on port conflicts.
config.sip.help.transport: Transport to the SIP server. UDP is common, TLS encrypts the signalling.
config.sip.help.prefer_srv: Looks the server up through DNS SRV records first. Turn on if your provider uses them.
config.sip.help.register_expires_seconds: How long a registration stays valid before AuraGo renews it (60-3600 seconds, default 300).
config.sip.help.advertised_signaling_hos: Public address AuraGo tells the server to reply to. Needed behind NAT or in Docker; otherwise leave empty.
config.sip.help.tls_server_name: Server name used to verify the TLS certificate. Leave empty to use the registrar.
config.sip.help.tls_cert_file: Path to the client certificate if the server requires mutual TLS authentication.
config.sip.help.tls_key_file: Path to the private key of the client certificate.
config.sip.help.media_rtp_port_start: First UDP port for audio data (RTP). Must be even and below the end port (default 30000).
config.sip.help.media_rtp_port_end: Last UDP port for audio data. The range limits the number of simultaneous calls (default 30099).
config.sip.help.media_advertised_host: Public address for the audio stream. Needed behind NAT or in Docker; otherwise leave empty.
config.sip.help.media_symmetric_rtp: Sends audio back to the address it arrives from. Helps behind NAT when the other side reports wrong addresses.
config.sip.help.media_jitter_buffer_ms: Buffer against varying packet delay (20-200 ms, default 60). Larger is steadier but delays the conversation.
config.sip.help.media_rtp_idle_timeout_s: Ends a call when no audio arrives for this long (15-600 seconds, default 60).
config.sip.help.media_codecs: Supported audio codecs in a fixed order of preference. This list cannot be changed here.
config.sip.help.browser_media_enabled: Allows calls through the microphone and speakers of the browser. A restart is needed after changing it.
config.sip.help.browser_media_bind_host: Local address for the browser audio stream. Empty uses 127.0.0.1.
config.sip.help.browser_media_udp_port: UDP port for the browser audio stream (1024-65535, default 30100).
config.sip.help.browser_media_advertised: IP address under which the browser reaches the audio stream. Needed when AuraGo does not run on the same device.
config.sip.help.inbound_ring_timeout_sec: How long an incoming call rings before it is rejected (15-300 seconds, default 90).
config.sip.help.permissions_answer_inbou: The agent may answer incoming calls.
config.sip.help.permissions_originate_ou: The agent may start calls on its own. Costs are charged by your phone provider.
config.sip.help.permissions_send_dtmf: The agent may send touch-tone keys, for example for phone system menus.
config.sip.help.permissions_agent_hangup: The agent may end running calls.
config.sip.help.history_retention_days: The call log is deleted after this time (1-3650 days, default 90).
